_comment: Subsystem modules for module-scoped audits (Development_Tools/ModuleMap/module_map.py). Every tracked file belongs to exactly one module, is a sharedTable (rows attributed by the UID or LocalizationKey they name), or is a picture/.art file owned by the module whose card names it. `module_map.py check AdvancedCopperTools` must exit 0.

modules.name: Armor and Shields
modules.summary: Helmet, Armor, Bracers, Greaves and Shield in every metal (merged cards, Metal Type in SpecialDurability4), the 23 retired per-metal cards that reforge into them, and the spiritual ward patch.

modules.name: Lighting and Oil
modules.summary: Metal Lantern (carried and placed), Lantern Oilwell, Copper Brazier, Copper Oil Flask, rendered and fish oil, and liquid-oil refuelling.

modules.name: Cookware, Heating and Preserved Food
modules.summary: Copper Stove and stove top mold, Cauldron, Tea Kettle, Wearable Metal Pan, Tinned Storage Pot, Bedwarming Pan, salt-cured meat and fish, and the heat/melt-fat/kettle/hammer-slot patches.

modules.name: Tea Blending
modules.summary: Tea Blending Station (kit, placed, lit), the calming, focus and warming teas, and its perk.

modules.name: Copper Bathtub
modules.summary: Copper Bathtub (kit, empty, full, warm; carried and placed) and its two perks.

modules.name: Wheelbarrow and Storage
modules.summary: Wheelbarrow and its parts (bucket, handles, wheel hub, rim, assembly), Copper Pantry, Ore Bin, and the wheelbarrow perks.

modules.name: Tools and Utility
modules.summary: Large Copper and Iron Saws, Grappling Hook, Tool Belt and its equipment slot, Cautery Iron and its burn stat, Copper Shears, Watering Can, Spigots and sap bucket, Copper-Rim Chamberpot.

modules.name: Metals and Materials
modules.summary: Iron Sheet, Iron Nail, Tin Ore and the Building Materials perk (the copper Metal Sheet, nails and solder live in the framework).

modules.name: Mod-wide
modules.summary: Plugin entry, the shared loader (GameLoadPatch: armor repair host, UID lists), the partner blueprint gate, project files, player docs, card motion, and art tooling state.
